bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
python3 - <<'PY'
import os
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path
root = Path('/home/admin1/projects/webhook-gateway')
p = root / '.env'
if p.is_symlink() or not p.is_file():
    raise SystemExit('ENV_FILE_INVALID')
before = p.read_bytes()
if not before.endswith(b'\n'):
    raise SystemExit('ENV_LINE_END_INVALID')
lines = before.decode('utf-8').splitlines()
base_name = 'DEST_SERVER_CORE_BOUNDED_HOST_URL='
new_name = 'DEST_SERVER_CORE_HOST_OUTPUT_URL='
bases = [x.split('=', 1)[1] for x in lines if x.startswith(base_name)]
if len(bases) != 1 or not bases[0].endswith('/internal/servercore-bounded-host'):
    raise SystemExit('EXISTING_DESTINATION_UNVERIFIED')
new_value = bases[0].rsplit('/', 1)[0] + '/internal/servercore-host-output'
existing = [x.split('=', 1)[1] for x in lines if x.startswith(new_name)]
if existing and (len(existing) != 1 or existing[0] != new_value):
    raise SystemExit('NEW_DESTINATION_CONFLICT')
addition = b''
if not existing:
    addition = (new_name + new_value + '\n').encode('utf-8')
    fd = os.open(p, os.O_WRONLY | os.O_APPEND | os.O_NOFOLLOW)
    try:
        if os.write(fd, addition) != len(addition):
            raise OSError('SHORT_WRITE')
        os.fsync(fd)
    finally:
        os.close(fd)
try:
    subprocess.run(['docker', 'compose', 'config', '--quiet'], cwd=root, stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL, stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL, timeout=20, check=True)
except Exception:
    if addition and p.read_bytes() == before + addition:
        fd = os.open(p, os.O_RDWR | os.O_NOFOLLOW)
        try:
            os.ftruncate(fd, len(before))
            os.fsync(fd)
        finally:
            os.close(fd)
    raise SystemExit('GATEWAY_COMPOSE_CONFIG_FAILED')
print('CU40_GATEWAY_ENV_CONFIG=PASS')
